scope: Offline exact effective HousingStore ground catalog only; no target execution, game, UI, server, listener, connection or live state.

selection.rule: http housing_catalog grantable=true intersect placement items with behaviour=ground and matching table/bundle/manifest hash

semantic_key.prefab: root-relative sibling-index chain + concrete class + zero-based GameObject component slot + registry kind
semantic_key.instance: layout digest + persisted ground array index + item ID + prefab semantic key
semantic_key.duplicate_evidence: Two copies of one item retain the same prefab key but have distinct persisted ground array indices.

policy.null_script_placeholder: Only exact 32-byte Unity-2018.4 base records with null script, absent type identity, no custom payload and exact owning GameObject are non-executable; all other unresolved scripts deny
